method.fleet: ABBA in fresh Electron processes, 43 frozen packages including optimized symbol coordinates, real SOFiSTiK LSP, Outline closed. Each process opens the supplied file at middle and 100 rows before EOF; requires 195778 symbols, types 60 inputs at 60 Hz, then 180 wheel events and six seconds observation. Settlement awaits syntax and any pending automatic indentation.
method.words: ABBA in fresh Electron Node processes. 6000 generated rows, Unicode and unique words; cold query followed by 8 cycles of repeated, refined, unrelated or edit-interleaved queries. Every full-result hash matches.
method.isolation: Core sources and package files are copied into separate local snapshots. Existing installed library dependencies are shared; the baseline native fuzzy dependency is retained in the isolated core. Private input is neither copied nor saved. Timing runs are serial and separate from tests/profiles.
method.limits: Compares JS model versions, not Superstring. Windows only; two processes per variant/condition. Frame timestamps do not measure physical presentation. Parser deadlines are cooperative; native comparison/cleanup can exceed them. Faster input can defer syntax publication.
